note: Field Inheritance inherits a field's value from a source entity into a read-only computed field on a destination entity. Each inheritance is a config entity (field_inheritance, prefix field_inheritance.field_inheritance.<id>) with keys id/label/type/source{EntityType,EntityBundle,Field}/destination{EntityType,EntityBundle,Field}/plugin; on save the id is auto-prefixed <destType>_<destBundle>_. Strategy `type` is one of inherit|prepend|append|fallback. Plugin is default_inheritance or entity_reference_inheritance (the field_inheritance plugin type, manager plugin.manager.field_inheritance). field_inheritance.config:included_entities (default block_content,file,node,taxonomy_term) controls which entity types participate. Configure route field_inheritance.field_inheritance (/admin/structure/field_inheritance); permission 'administer field inheritance'. On this site node bundles are article and page and article has a body field. Medium/hard cases create/inspect a real field_inheritance config entity that inherits node/article body into node/page (ids are auto-prefixed to node_page_fi_known / node_page_fi_task).

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal Field Inheritance module do, and what inheritance strategies (types) can you choose when configuring an inheritance?
evals.expected_output: It inherits a field's value from a source entity into a read-only computed field on a destination entity (a field-level alternative to entity reference). The strategy (type) is one of: inherit, prepend, append, fallback.

evals.prompt: Where are Field Inheritance inheritances managed in the Drupal admin, and what is the config entity type / config prefix used to store one?
evals.expected_output: Manage them at /admin/structure/field_inheritance (route field_inheritance.field_inheritance, permission 'administer field inheritance'). Each is a config entity of type field_inheritance, stored as field_inheritance.field_inheritance.<id>.

evals.prompt: Field Inheritance defines its own plugin type for inheritance behaviour. Which two inheritance plugins ship with the module, and which one is used for entity_reference/image/file fields?
evals.expected_output: The field_inheritance plugin type ships default_inheritance (any field) and entity_reference_inheritance (used for entity_reference, image, file, webform, paragraphs, entity_reference_revisions).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Field Inheritance configured that inherits data into the Page content type. Inspect the live field_inheritance configuration and state which source field it inherits from.
evals.expected_output: The inheritance node_page_fi_known inherits from sourceField 'body' (of node/article). Inspect field_inheritance.field_inheritance.node_page_fi_known, or FieldInheritance::load('node_page_fi_known')->sourceField().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the Field Inheritance module to create an inheritance with id `fi_task` that uses the `inherit` strategy to inherit the Article content type's body field (source: node / article / body) into the Page content type (destination: node / page), using the default_inheritance plugin. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a field_inheritance config entity (id fi_task; it saves as node_page_fi_task) with type=inherit, sourceEntityType=node, sourceEntityBundle=article, sourceField=body, destinationEntityType=node, destinationEntityBundle=page, plugin=default_inheritance. Verified: an inheritance matching fi_task exists with type inherit, source node body, destination node/page.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Field Inheritance that inherits the Article body into the Page content type. Inspect the live field_inheritance configuration and state which inheritance strategy (type) it uses.
evals.expected_output: The inheritance node_page_fi_strat uses the 'append' strategy (its `type` is append). Inspect field_inheritance.field_inheritance.node_page_fi_strat, or FieldInheritance::load('node_page_fi_strat')->type().

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the Field Inheritance module to create an inheritance with id `fi_fb` that uses the `fallback` strategy: the Page content type should show its own body field, falling back to the Article content type's body when empty. Source: node / article / body; destination: node / page with destination field body; plugin default_inheritance. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a field_inheritance config entity (id fi_fb; saves as node_page_fi_fb) with type=fallback, sourceEntityType=node, sourceEntityBundle=article, sourceField=body, destinationEntityType=node, destinationEntityBundle=page, destinationField=body, plugin=default_inheritance. Verified: an inheritance matching fi_fb exists with type fallback, source node body, destination node/page.
